observations: Photo 0 shows a white industrial sewing machine on a metal table with red feet, labeled 'Emel' on the front frame.
Photo 1 shows the same machine from a side angle, with the brand 'Emel' visible on the front and on the table surface.
Photo 2 shows the machine from a wider angle, with a metal stand and additional equipment on the left side of the table.
The machine has a motor under the table, a needle and presser foot assembly, and a thread stand.
The table surface is white with red trim on the edge in photo 2.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or storage area with a worn wall and tiled floor.
No visible damage to the machine or table, but no close-up of the needle, motor, or internal components.

claims.claim: Fairly used Emel industrial sewing machine
claims.evidence: Brand 'Emel' is visible on the machine and table in all photos. The term 'fairly used' is subjective but consistent with the condition shown.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage (e.g., motor, needle, or timing issues).
risks.proof: Close-up video or photo of the motor running, needle movement, and internal components.

risks.risk: Missing accessories or parts (e.g., foot pedal, power cord, bobbins, presser feet).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out.

risks.risk: Wear and tear on the table or stand, especially around the legs and joints.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the table legs and joints.

proof_requests: Close-up video of the motor running and needle moving.
Photo of all included accessories (foot pedal, power cord, bobbins, presser feet).
Close-up photo of the table legs and joints to check for wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
